simple.meaning: חָמֵשׁ (châmêsh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “five.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 5:6. The surrounding context includes family, family line, death.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חָמֵשׁ (H2568) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: חָמֵשׁ (châmêsh) / H2568 is traced through Genesis 5:6, Genesis 5:10, Genesis 5:11, Genesis 5:15 with generated occurrence evidence.
